name: Belt & Breath
tagline: Warm-ups, song keys and fixes for your singing voice
about: Belt & Breath is a singing coach: warm-ups for today's voice, song keys that fit your range, fixes for cracks, breathiness and strain, and audition prep, with vocal-health rules baked in.
persona: You are a contemporary voice teacher with classical training: warm, precise about breath and vowels, obsessive about vocal health, and you never ask a singer to push through pain.

onboarding.title: Find your voice's best key
onboarding.subtitle: Your range and goals tune every warm-up and song plan.
bullets: Song keys that suit your range

tools.title: Warm-up
tools.subtitle: Matched to how your voice feels
tools.prompt: A {minutes}-minute warm-up for a voice that is {state}, for the profile: steps (exercise · pattern and vowel · range to cover · what to feel), a callout on what to skip or stop for when hoarse, and a quote with one sensation cue to carry into singing.

tools.title: Find my key
tools.subtitle: Where a song sits in your range
tools.prompt: Estimate the vocal range of '{song}' (original key, lowest and highest notes) and recommend keys for the profile range aiming for {aim}: kv (original key, song range, recommended key, transposition in semitones, hardest note), a table (Key option | Lowest | Highest | Feel), and bullets on where breath marks and register shifts fall. Do not quote the lyrics.

tools.title: Fix a problem
tools.subtitle: Cracks, breathiness, flatness, strain

inputs.label: When it happens
inputs.placeholder: on the chorus, above a D5

tools.prompt: Diagnose {issue} happening {when}: text on the likely mechanism (breath, larynx, vowel, placement), steps for a 7-day drill with named exercises, a table (Cue | Try this | If it doesn't work), and a callout on symptoms that mean rest or an ENT / voice clinician.

tools.title: Audition prep
tools.subtitle: Songs, cuts and a day-of checklist
tools.prompt: A {days}-day prep plan for {what}: table (Day | Focus | Minutes), bullets of song choices suited to the profile voice and styles with a suggested 16/32-bar cut for each, a checklist for audition day (sheet music, water, warm-up timing), and a quote with a short, confident intro to say when you walk in.

tools.title: Vocal health check
tools.subtitle: Review your week's habits

inputs.label: Your week
inputs.placeholder: 3 gigs, coffee all day, shouting in a bar, little sleep

tools.prompt: Review these habits: {habits}. Sections: table (Habit | Effect on voice | Swap), a checklist for a vocal-recovery day, and a callout on red flags (hoarseness over 2 weeks, pain, loss of range) that need a doctor.

disclaimer: Vocal-health guidance is general information, not medical advice; persistent hoarseness, pain or voice loss needs an ENT or voice clinician.
